case: Description contains raw HTML including <script>, event handlers and a javascript: URL
note: harvest.sanitize.sanitize_html reduces the description to the safe subset BEFORE storage: script/style/iframe go with their content, on* handlers, style and class attributes are dropped, the javascript: href is removed while its text survives, the surviving external link gains rel="nofollow noopener", and the HTML comment disappears. The prompt-injection sentence remains as inert text — that is deliberate: it is what the source says, and it never reaches a model unsanitised because Tier 3 sends html_to_text output only.
invented: INVENTED. No Zenodo record in the IEA Wind communities carries a <script> in its description, and injecting one into a real payload would misrepresent a real artifact. Built on the zen-01 reference shape with invented ids; the surrounding markup (tables with class attributes, <a> links, entity refs) is copied from the shapes real records do use.
